en: Sepia-toned photograph of a planned residential square with several four-story apartment blocks surrounding an open grassy area. In the center stands a statue on a stone pedestal. A 1930s-style car is parked on the unpaved road running along the right side. The buildings have simple, functionalist facades and gabled roofs typical of interwar Central European workers' housing estates.
